_doc: The commands this repo pins, and the commands whose whole output is the evidence. Read by the command guard (PreToolUse on Bash). Empty below on purpose: a rule you have not declared never fires. 'pinned' maps a command to the form this repo requires; the key matches the basename of the first token, so 'python' catches /usr/bin/python but not python3 (declare both if you want both), and a multi-word key like 'kmem notes index' pins one subcommand. 'evidence_commands' lists commands whose full output is the evidence; one of them piped into head, tail, sed -n or grep -m is refused. Turn the whole guard off with "command_guard": false in the k-mem config.
